item.tib: zhi ba bder gshegs rab 'byams phrin las zab don bang mdzod
item.coloph: zhi ba gsas mkhar rab 'byams zhes bya ba/ sprul sku gshen rab bla ma'i thugs dgongs/ dbal bon stag la me 'bar gyi brnag pa/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha'i lung don/ stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyis/ phyi rab (rabs) 'gro ba'i don ched du/ skal ldan skyes bu khyod la gtad/ gsang sbas thabs la mkhas par gyis/ ces gsung (gsungs) nas bka'i gdams pa gnang*/ bdag gis sbas dang gsang rgya thub pa byas/ mtshan ldan bla ma'i gsung gis rab bskul nas/ dkar chab (chag) yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la mthol lo gshegs (bshags)/ bka' skyongs srung ma rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge ba'i 'gro kun bde chen sa thob shog/
